jwks.description: Application 公钥 checking its private_key_jwt assertions, as a JWKS of public RSA (2048 bits or more) and EC P-256 keys, each with a distinct kid, at most 5; replaces the registered set, absent keeps it. Not for public Applications.

loginMethods.description: The login methods it offers (ADR 0027). Absent follows the instance, the default: whatever the instance has on, Providers added later included. sessionIdleTimeout.description: Seconds a Session may sit idle; 0 for the default (30 days browser, 90 days App)

sessionMaxLifetime.description: Seconds a Session may last from the User's last sign-in or re-authentication, however active; 0 for the default (90 days browser, 180 days App). At least the idle timeout in effect

tokenAuthMethod.description: How it authenticates at the token endpoint; none for a public Application. Switch it with the auth-method operation.

The client secret of a confidential Application; shown this once

config.description: By field key; an empty secret field keeps the stored value

id.description: Provider ID: a slug in the callback URL, never changed

name.description: Shown on the login page: 使用 {name} 登录

identifier.description: +86 phone number, email or username; stored normalised. An admin-typed phone number or email counts as verified at once: no code is sent (ADR 0016). Already held by another User: 409, with that User's sub in the body, and nothing is written

invite.description: Send a 注册邀请 instead of setting an initial password: the User is made 待激活 and sets their own, so the admin never knows it. 互斥 with password and password_hash, and the Identifier must be an email. An invite that fails to send leaves the User made but with no usable link: re-send it from the User's page

password.description: The initial password the admin hands over: the User is made 待激活 and must replace it at first sign-in before they get any token. 互斥 with invite and password_hash

password_hash.description: Import the User with the password hash they had in the 集成方's old user store (ADR 0033): argon2id in PHC string format, or bcrypt ($2a$, $2b$, $2y$); any other format is a 422. The User is made normal, not 待激活, and their first sign-in with it re-stores it as argon2id. 互斥 with password and invite. With none of the three, the User is made normal with just the Identifier and signs in by code, so a username alone is refused. password, invite and password_hash are each a 422 while 密码登录 is off; the Identifier alone is not

logins.description: Sessions signed in to that day, as loginsToday counts them

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

secret.description: Sealed with the master key and never read back

state.description: none: 没发出过 (or it was revoked or has expired); sent: a link is out there and nobody has used it; accepted: the last invite was spent by the User themselves
